skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with a 2-hit combo, dealing 60% AT damage. Grants self [Tenacity] (absorbs damage equal to 10% of own HP).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 130% AT damage to targets in a cross area. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Injured] on the main target for 2 turns (adds Injured damage equal to 50% ATK when attacked). Shares 40% of the damage taken by the 2 lowest-HP allies for 2 turns, reducing the shared damage taken% (no longer shares once HP drops below 20%).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 160% AT damage to targets in a cross area. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Injured] on the main target for 2 turns (adds Injured damage equal to 50% ATK when attacked). Shares 40% of the damage taken by the 2 lowest-HP allies for 2 turns, reducing the shared damage taken by 40% (no longer shares once HP drops below 20%).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When battle begins, grants allies in the same row and self 40% Ultimate DMG Free for 2 turns. The first time fatal damage is taken each battle, heals self for 30% of max HP.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When battle begins, grants allies in the same row and self 50% Ultimate DMG Free for 2 turns. The first time fatal damage is taken each battle, heals self for 40% of max HP.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When battle begins, grants allies in the same row and self 55% Ultimate DMG Free for 2 turns. The first time fatal damage is taken each battle, heals self for 45% of max HP.

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
